0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000010_LYSENARRATION
0.description: I remember my father's words.<hex:02100103>How they rang in my ears as we left Castrum Abania behind and looked out over the lochs before us.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000020_LYSENARRATION
1.description: Comrades brave and true. They had come from all across Eorzea to stand with us.<hex:02100103>To stand against oppression and tyranny.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000030_LYSENARRATION
2.description: Twenty years the Empire had ruled us, but no longer.<hex:02100103>Liberty or death. Liberty or death.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000040_RAUBAHN
3.description: Ere we begin, I would say to you, as a proud son of Ala Mhigo, that I am grateful to each and every one of you for your part in this endeavor.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000050_RAUBAHN
4.description: Now, to the heart of the matter. The enemy appears content to remain within the city walls and await the inevitable siege. Open conflict has been sporadic thus far.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000060_RAUBAHN
5.description: Whether Zenos is biding his time until reinforcements arrive or attempting to bait us into a trap, none can say. We know better than to trust his word.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000070_PIPIN
6.description: Regardless, we can ill afford to present Garlemald with a chance to ready her legions. It would be in our best interests to press for a swift resolution.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000080_LYSE
7.description: A long siege wouldn't be good for the people in the city either.<hex:02100103>If food becomes scarce, you know who'll starve first.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000090_RAUBAHN
8.description: Just so. Therefore, I propose we commit our forces to an all-out assault.<hex:02100103>What say you?

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000100_RAUBAHN
9.description: 'Twould seem we are of one mind. Then let us proceed to the how of it.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000110_RAUBAHN
10.description: The Immortal Flames will form the vanguard, supported by the archers and the conjurers of the Order of the Twin Adder, under the Elder Seedseer's command.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000120_RAUBAHN
11.description: Once the main host has cleared a path to the walls, we will bring forward the artillery of the Maelstrom and the Temple Knights.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000130_RAUBAHN
12.description: I would have your cannons pound the gates, and punch a hole right through the middle of their defenses!

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000150_RAUBAHN
14.description: Your part will be to occupy the residential district and keep civilians out of harm's way. The people are more like to trust their own.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000160_LYSE
15.description: Of course. You can count on us!

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000170_RAUBAHN
16.description: Remember that there is a second entrance to the city proper there. If all goes to plan, we will have secured two points of entry.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000180_RAUBAHN
17.description: Once both objectives are complete, we press on into the city, surround the palace, and hunt down Zenos.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000190_RAUBAHN
18.description: As for the Scions, you will be held in reserve as an irregular unit until we have more intelligence on your captured comrade. Krile's rescue will be your primary concern, but I daresay we'll find a use for you once her freedom has been secured.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000200_ALPHINAUD
19.description: Thank you, General. I pray we find her quickly.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000210_RAUBAHN
20.description: Rhalgr's Beacon nears its end.<hex:02100103>Soon, my friends, Ala Mhigo will be ours once more!

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000240_FORDOLA
23.description: [HIT HARD AND SENT FLYING REAX GRUNT]

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000250_FORDOLA
24.description: No... Not after everything... I cannot lose... I will not!

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000260_LYSE
25.description: Oh, but you will. Without your tricks, you're nothing!

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000270_LYSE
26.description: Conrad, Meffrid, your own comrades!<hex:02100103>I should kill you here and now for what you did!

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000280_LYSE
27.description: But there's no place for that kind of justice here. Not in my Ala Mhigo.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000290_FORDOLA
28.description: Oh, how very bloody noble of you! Pffft. You'll pardon me my sins, will you? After you and your “freedom fighters” come and tear down everything we've worked so hard to build!? We were fighting for our people's freedom!

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000300_LYSE
29.description: You're slaves to a tyrant! There's no freedom in that!

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000350_THANCRED
34.description: Touching as this moment is, it will have to wait. We should rejoin the main force at once.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000370_LYSE
36.description: I'm taking her back with us. Alive. She's going to answer for what she's done.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000380_FORDOLA
37.description: Heh heh heh...listen to you, talking like you've already won. Zenos is going to tear you apart. He commands a power echoing that of the eikons.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000400_FORDOLA
39.description: The hunt, you stupid cow─I'm talking about the hunt! He said you'd come. And here you are, his willing prey.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000410_FORDOLA
40.description: You and your friends are dead─just like mine. And all our misery, all our sacrifice...it was all for naught!

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000420_LYSE
41.description: ...No. You're gonna live long enough to see us win our freedom.<hex:02100103>I promise you that.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000430_FORDOLA
42.description: May I live a thousand years...

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000440_THANCRED
43.description: Interrogations can wait. Let us be off!

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000450_RAUBAHN
44.description: Ah, the heroes of the hour! Not content with securing the residential district, you gifted me an imperial commander. What are you after, a medal?

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000460_ALPHINAUD
45.description: The work is its own reward, General. I must say, however, that Fordola's claims were not a little disturbing. What manner of power could Zenos have acquired that might equal an eikon?

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000470_RAUBAHN
46.description: Might she speak of our missing Omega?

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000480_ALPHINAUD
47.description: Very possibly. The Empire's fondness for comparable Allagan technologies is exceedingly well documented. Have we made any progress with our own investigation?

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000490_RAUBAHN
48.description: None. The search goes on in earnest, but Cid has thus far found nothing of note. Mayhap the Garleans beat us to it. If they were working desperately<hex:02100103>to repair the machine, that might explain their decision to remain within<hex:02100103>their walls...

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000500_ALPHINAUD
49.description: Ah, Lyse. I trust you surrendered Fordola into custody without incident.<hex:02100103>We were just discussing the pilus's claims.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000510_LYSE
50.description: About Zenos and his newfound powers? She hasn't said a word on the subject since we rescued Krile─even when the interrogator asked nicely.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000520_KRILE
51.description: Mayhap I can offer some insight into her claims─or at least into the facility and the experiments they conducted during my time there. Though my memories of the period are somewhat muddled, there are a few things I remember with painful clarity.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000530_ALPHINAUD
52.description: Thancred told us only that Fordola had undergone some...manner of treatment...

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000540_KRILE
53.description: Yes... It is a place wholly dedicated to the creation of enhanced beings whom they refer to as “the Resonant.” As I understand it, the process aims to<hex:02100103>imbue a test subject with the qualities of an individual with demonstrated<hex:02100103>magical aptitude.<hex:02100103>This entails... This entails the m-mechanical extraction and transfusion of some manner of...primordial essence.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000550_LYSE
54.description: So that's how Fordola improved so fast. I knew there had to be something.<hex:02100103>She wasn't half as strong or quick to predict my attacks when we first met.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000560_LYSE
55.description: If it weren't for Urianger's siphon thingy, I really don't think we'd have<hex:02100103>beaten her...

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000570_URIANGER
56.description: My humble scheme asked far more in the execution than it required in the conception, I do assure thee.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000580_LYSE
57.description: Oh, you have got to stop doing that.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000590_URIANGER
58.description: In calling upon Lady Alisaie after her defeat, I was most intrigued to learn of the apparent effortlessness with which Fordola countered her attacks. 'Twas as if she knew the blade's destination ere its journey began.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000600_URIANGER
59.description: A most impressive feat under any circumstances, but an almost miraculous<hex:02100103>one when considered in the context of Fordola's unfamiliarity with my<hex:02100103>lady's arts. How then could she so perfectly predict an unknown opponent's<hex:02100103>every move?

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000610_URIANGER
60.description: After much deliberation, I surmised that Fordola may be possessed of a preternatural ability to divine meaning from the fluctuations of an individual's aether, and to instinctively react. To employ a metaphor, one might say that she was attuned to the whispers of my lady Alisaie's soul.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000620_ALPHINAUD
61.description: Wait! Have you not just described a manifestation of the Echo?

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000630_URIANGER
62.description: I had no conclusive proof. The available anecdotal evidence suggested only that Fordola was uncommonly sensitive to aetheric fluctuations, and 'twas this which led me to develop my stratagem.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000640_URIANGER
63.description: I would fashion a device with the capacity to generate a massive disruption<hex:02100103>in the surrounding aether. If, as I suspected, Fordola's senses were<hex:02100103>indeed questing for the most minor of oscillations, the shock of exposure<hex:02100103>to a more amplitudinous aetheric waveform would be akin to a debilitating<hex:02100103>bout of aether sickness.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000650_ALPHINAUD
64.description: How...ingenious. I note that the success of your plan hinged on your device's wielder remaining ignorant of its purpose, lest Fordola divine your intent.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000660_URIANGER
65.description: Indeed so, Master Alphinaud.<hex:02100103>All things considered, 'twas a most fortuitous outcome.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000670_KRILE
66.description: That's putting it mildly. In any event, if Urianger is correct, that would mean these Resonant have been granted the power of the Echo via artificial means. A sobering thought to say the least─and one which makes me wonder what else Zenos has in store.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000680_RAUBAHN
67.description: Whatever the viceroy's newfound powers, I know of none better equipped to face him. And face him you must. For there is now but one path forward, and it leads straight to Ala Mhigo.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000690_LYSE
68.description: And it's not as if we came unprepared. We've got all our friends and allies fighting for the same thing. Honestly, right now, I feel like we could take on anyone and win. And I mean anyone!

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
70.description: Victory is as good as ours!

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
71.description: Nevertheless, let us proceed with all due caution.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000700_LYSE
73.description: Exactly! Ohhh, I wouldn't want to be in Zenos's boots!<hex:02100103>Not with the likes of us coming to get him!

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000710_LYSE
74.description: Well, no one's saying we shouldn't be cautious!<hex:02100103>...Though maybe I was getting a bit carried away.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000720_LYSE
75.description: Enough talking! All right, all right! I get the message!<hex:02100103>Action is what's needed now!

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000730_LYSE
76.description: Right─I'd best get back to the residential district. Thancred and the Resistance forces are waiting.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000740_ALPHINAUD
77.description: It is time we joined the main host.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000750_ALPHINAUD
78.description: Krile, in light of your recent ordeal...might I suggest that you remain with the rear guard for now?

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000760_KRILE
79.description: Oh, if you insist...just this once.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000770_PIPIN
80.description: Ah, you are returned. Were your negotiations with the wolfmen successful?

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000780_ALPHINAUD
81.description: The one they call the White was receptive to our words once we told him of Doma's liberation.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000790_ALPHINAUD
82.description: They withdrew behind the walls to inform their brethren. If the gods are good, no blood shall be shed between our peoples this day.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000800_PIPIN
83.description: Hear, hear. Now...I think it's time we did something about those gates.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000820_PIPIN
85.description: Give me hellfire! Give me Ifrit's bloody inferno!

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000830_PIPIN
86.description: Now give me a Coerthan winter! Enough ice and snow to bury a behemoth!

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000840_PIPIN
87.description: All cannons, fire at will! Let no man say we neglected to knock!

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000850_PIPIN
88.description: Damn that armor! We nearly had it!

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000870_HIEN
90.description: Bear witness, my Eorzean brothers and sisters!<hex:02100103>Doma is come to pay her debts!

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000890_HIEN
92.description: We will deal with the flying machines!<hex:02100103>Forward, my friends! For freedom and justice!

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000900_PIPIN
93.description: You heard the man! All cannons, resume firing!

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000910_ALPHINAUD
94.description: We're through! The way is clear!

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000930_ZENOS
96.description: Ahahahahahaha! Yes, yes! Such ferocity, such tenacity!

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000940_ZENOS
97.description: I am loath to recall how disappointed I was when first we fought...but finally, finally, after bathing in the blood and offal of your enemies, finally you prove yourself worthy prey for the hunt!

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000950_ZENOS
98.description: It fills you even now, doesn't it? The hunger. To bite down on my jugular, to feel the warmth fill your mouth and run over even as you drink deep. Good, good! This is the beast I have longed to face!

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000960_ZENOS
99.description: As you sharpened your claws, I too sought newfound strength! But this is no place for a final contest. Come! The heavens shall bear witness to our dance!

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000965_ALPHINAUD
101.description: Go after Zenos, my friend! We shall deal with this!

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000980_ZENOS
103.description: The King of Ruin built this place for his foreign queen. He kept it filled with familiar creatures from her homeland. They bored me all.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_000990_ZENOS
104.description: This fine specimen, on the other hand, is simply...divine.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001000_ZENOS
105.description: Your fates are entwined, are they not, eikon-slayer? This dragon, this...embodiment of unbridled despair, born of a desperate man's burning hatred for the Empire...

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001010_ZENOS
106.description: How raw the raging tempest that churns within its breast. No myth made manifest this, but...a being of pure violence.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001020_ZENOS
107.description: Hah hah, mayhap you are the true architect of our design. You who fought the very soul of vengeance to the edge and watched him fall; you who let slip the Allagan hound to drive this eikon into my arms!

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001030_ZENOS
108.description: Oh... My. Have I said too much? Forgive me, this...sensation is wholly unfamiliar to me.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001040_ZENOS
109.description: A question, then─and I should like very much for you to speak from the heart. If I were to stand aside, what would you do to this eikon?

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001050_ZENOS
114.description: Ah. As simple as that. But of course. You are the eikon-slayer. Such certainty is to be expected.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001060_ZENOS
115.description: But have I not already bound it with Omega's restraints? And does not the Seventh Umbral Calamity stand as a testament to the fallibility of such devices? Oh, how quickly we forget.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001070_ZENOS
116.description: Hm. You will not indulge me even with a simple reply, then? No. You think only of the fight to come. How alike we are.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001080_ZENOS
117.description: A pity. There is another alternative. Or there would be...had you only mastered your abilities.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001090_ZENOS
118.description: I speak of the Echo, of course. Does it merely render you immune to eikonic influence? Or is it rather that your influence is far greater than theirs? Granted, these implications are of no moment to a savage, who thinks only of killing the beast before him...

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001100_ZENOS
119.description: But when I read van Baelsar's reports, I immediately saw the boundless potential of the Echo. I saw how it could be instrumental in binding an eikon to one's will. Hence my research and the Resonant─and oh so much more!

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001110_ZENOS
120.description: All eikons must be exterminated, without exception. Such was the imperial mandate issued by my great-grandfather after he saw firsthand the destruction wrought by one such being. They are a blight upon this star, he felt, and so he began his great and just crusade.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001120_ZENOS
121.description: Pah! 'Twas not justice which spurred his campaign, but fear! Fear of the eikons, fear of their power. Cowardice made them march forth to battle. Pathetic!

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001130_ZENOS
122.description: Man should fight for the joy of it. To live, to eat, to breed─lesser beasts snap and howl at one another for this. Only man has the wisdom and the clarity to embrace violence for its own sake.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001140_ZENOS
123.description: For we who are born into this merciless, meaningless world, have but one candle of life to burn.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001150_ZENOS
124.description: I know you understand this. You and I are one and the same.<hex:02100103>Together, we could while away the quiet hours, as friend and confidant...if you will accept me.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001160_ZENOS
128.description: Heh heh...are we to embrace and let bygones be bygones? Do our deeds weigh so little that you would cast all aside? Come. 'Twas plain from the first how this would end.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001170_ZENOS
129.description: Heh heh...and yet, in doing so, you prove me right. We are warriors. 'Twas plain from the first how this would end.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001180_ZENOS
130.description: You live for these moments─when all hangs in the balance...when the difference between life and death is but a single stroke.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001190_ZENOS
131.description: I live for them too! This is who we are, my friend! This is all we are!<hex:02100103>Ala Mhigo and Doma and Garlemald be damned!

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001200_ZENOS
132.description: We tower above the gods! You by your gift, I by my might!

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001210_ZENOS
133.description: And before the Resonant the gods shall be made to kneel!

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001220_ZENOS
134.description: An ending to mark a new beginning!

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001260_ZENOS
138.description: Hah...hah...hah... The hunter has indeed become the hunted.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001270_ZENOS
139.description: And yet...there is only joy. Transcendent joy that I have never known.<hex:02100103>How invigorating, how...pure, this feeling.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001280_LYSE
140.description: Is that what this was all about? All the meaningless death and destruction?<hex:02100103>So you could feel something!?

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001290_ZENOS
141.description: Meaningless? Men die that others may live.<hex:02100103>Those who survive are stronger for it.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001300_ZENOS
142.description: Not that you could ever understand. To have stood upon this great stage of fools...to have played my part to perfection...

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001310_ZENOS
143.description: Oh, this...this moment...let it be enshrined in eternity. My heart...beating out of time... So clear, so vivid, so real... So real.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001340_ZENOS
146.description: Farewell, my first friend. My enemy.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001360_ALPHINAUD
148.description: He's dead. By his own hand.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001370_ALPHINAUD
149.description: He's dead. By his own hand.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001390_LYSE
151.description: No...there's no justice in that...in that rabid animal's end.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001400_ALPHINAUD
152.description: Liberty or death. That so many should be forced to take up this creed to defeat such madness...

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001410_RAUBAHN
153.description: We won. Forget him. The living have need of us now.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001420_HIEN
154.description: Stand tall, Lyse! Now is the time to raise a cheer for all who fought for freedom! A cheer loud enough to carry to the highest heavens!

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001440_LYSE
156.description: Thank you. Without you... Well...you know.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001450_LYSE
157.description: So let's do it together. For Ala Mhigo!

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001451_SONGALAMHIGO_NONE_VOICE
158.description: O come ye wayward brothers,<hex:02100103>Bereft of hearth and home,

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001452_SONGALAMHIGO_NONE_VOICE
159.description: Beneath yon burning star there lies<hex:02100103>A haven for the bold.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001453_SONGALAMHIGO_NONE_VOICE
160.description: Raise up your hands and voices,<hex:02100103>Let fill your hearts with pride,

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001454_SONGALAMHIGO_NONE_VOICE
161.description: Above the churning waters we<hex:02100103>Stand strong and unified.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001460_LYSENARRATION
162.description: In crimson it began, and in crimson it ended.<hex:02100103>And then...and then we were free.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001471_LYSE
164.description: We may be free to live, to love, to grow old. To have dreams and desires, and to strive for them.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001480_LYSE
165.description: But in the end, we're defined by the legacy our forefathers bequeath to us.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001481_LYSE
166.description: Even Zenos was once a baby in the cradle, innocent and pure.<hex:02100103>He was made into a creature that lived only for death, not born one.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001490_LYSE
167.description: Twenty years of imperial rule have left Ala Mhigo torn and bleeding.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001491_LYSE
168.description: It won't be easy to heal a generation's worth of wounds, to bridge the gap.<hex:02100103>But I won't give up, Papalymo. I won't.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001500_LYSE
169.description: Because I remember the price of freedom.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001501_LYSE
170.description: I remember the smoke and the ashes and the blood. I remember the screams...and the silence.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001510_LYSE
171.description: And I'll do whatever it takes to honor their sacrifice. To build a home for us all. I promise you.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001521_LYSE
173.description: The end of the imperial province of Ala Mhigo, and the rebirth of Ala Mhigo the free nation. Long may she endure.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001530_ESTINIEN
174.description: Well, well, well, what a fine mess we've made.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001540_ESTINIEN
175.description: All but spent feeding that primal, eh? Well, you won't be making any mischief with that amount of aether.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001560_ESTINIEN
177.description: There. There ends your hateful legacy.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001570_LYSE
178.description: We've been through a lot together, haven't we? I can't thank you enough.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001580_LYSE
179.description: There's something I need to say to you all. That is, if you have a moment...?

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001590_LYSE
180.description: Good, you're all here. Good, good...

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001600_LYSE
181.description: "Thank you“ doesn't really suffice, does it? I'm grateful...truly grateful, from the bottom of my heart.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001610_LYSE
182.description: But I know you didn't fight so hard just to hear me or anyone else say that. You fought because you wanted to help─because you believed it was right. Because you're Scions.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001620_LYSE
183.description: Now, I'm obviously a Scion, but as Conrad left me in charge of things here,<hex:02100103>I also have responsibilities to Ala Mhigo...

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001630_LYSE
184.description: When I put it like that, though...I realized I couldn't even pretend to be impartial anymore. So it seemed best to make it official.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001640_LYSE
185.description: As long as I serve Ala Mhigo, I can't be a Scion. It might be selfish and shortsighted...but that's my decision.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001650_YSHTOLA
186.description: Am I to understand that you summoned us all─some of us still nursing wounds─to hear this?

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001670_YSHTOLA
188.description: Hahaha! Forgive me, Lyse! 'Twas but a jest.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001680_YSHTOLA
189.description: But this I say with the utmost sincerity: Scion or no, we are comrades.<hex:02100103>Now and ever after.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001700_YSHTOLA
191.description: There you have it. Come what may, you may count on us in your hour of need. We shall never refuse you.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001710_LYSE
192.description: Y'shtola... Oh gods, I swore I wouldn't cry...

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001720_GOSETSU
193.description: (-???-)Come back here, you slippery little devil! <grumble><hex:02100103>To think fishing could be so difficult!

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001730_GOSETSU
194.description: (-???-)What greater proof of a man's lingering mortality than an empty belly.<hex:02100103>A fate worse than death.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001740_GOSETSU
195.description: (-???-)Fie on it. To have arrived at the appointed place and time, only to survive by mere force of habit. Truly, the kami are not finished with us yet.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04006_001750_GOSETSU
196.description: O capricious fortune! How you test me with this wretched soul...
